caseName: Golden State Transit Corp. v. City of Los Angeles
caseNameFull: Golden State Transit Corp. v. City of Los Angeles

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Certiorari granted limited to the following question: “Whether in the absence of a direct violation of a federal statute, an allegation that a state statute is preempted by a federal statute is cognizable under 42 U. S. C. § 1983?”
